name: iso-toolkit
title: ISO Toolkit
description: Boot, write and format ISO images without a USB drive.
author: black

commands.name: index
commands.title: Boot ISO (GRUB Loopback)
commands.description: Install a GRUB loopback entry to boot an ISO without a USB drive.

commands.name: kexec-iso
commands.title: Boot ISO (kexec)
commands.description: Boot an ISO live environment via kexec without GRUB.

commands.name: write-usb
commands.title: Write ISO to USB
commands.description: Write an ISO image to a USB drive with dd.

commands.name: format-usb
commands.title: Format USB drive
commands.description: Format a USB drive with a chosen filesystem.

commands.name: eject-usb
commands.title: Eject USB drive
commands.description: Unmount and eject a USB drive.

commands.name: list-devices
commands.title: List block devices
commands.description: Show block devices with sizes, models and mountpoints.

commands.name: recent
commands.title: Recent ISOs and devices
commands.description: Show recently used ISO files and devices.
